scenes.title: The discovery

lines.text: [matter-of-fact] There she is. Class-nine extraterrestrial spacecraft. Perkins, we're getting inside.
[nervous] How?
[dryly] Historically? At the cost of the professor's assistant.

scenes.direction: Deep alien hum. Slow cyan sweeps across L and R. G pulses green.

scenes.title: Try the door

lines.text: [matter-of-fact] Let's not overcomplicate this. Perkins, pull the handle.
[hesitant] Oh, sure, I can just...
[shouts] AAAAGH!

scenes.direction: Sharp electrical ZZZZAP! Blinding white-blue burst across all three lights.

scenes.title: Scientific analysis

lines.text: [matter-of-fact] Interesting. A high-voltage bioelectric deterrent. Quite sophisticated.
[dryly] There's a lightning bolt painted on the door.
[matter-of-fact] Yes, thank you.

scenes.direction: No effect. Steady workshop glow and room tone; next sound and light payoff is the crowbar.

scenes.title: The crowbar

lines.text: [matter-of-fact] Fine. We'll use mechanical leverage. Perkins, the crowbar.
[nervous] Got it. One... two... THREE!

scenes.direction: Metal CLANG! Alien security alarm. Alternating aggressive red sweeps on L and R.

scenes.title: The alarm

lines.text: [nervous] IS THAT BAD?!
[matter-of-fact] Just a proximity alarm.
[dryly] It's broadcasting our coordinates to eleven hostile civilizations. Twelve now.

scenes.direction: Technical transmission beeps on broadcasting, then warbling alien digital alarm with red pulses.

scenes.title: The blowtorch

lines.text: [matter-of-fact] Let's introduce some heat. Perkins, fire up the plasma torch.
[nervous] Finally, something I'm qualified to...

scenes.direction: Torch WHOOSH, rising whine, enormous BOOM! G orange, L/R intense white-orange bursts. Fog blast.

scenes.title: More scientific analysis

lines.text: [matter-of-fact] Ah! The hull anticipates thermal attacks three seconds before they occur.
[dryly] Fascinating. It anticipated Perkins being on fire.

scenes.direction: Small sputtering flames, smoky orange flickers. Perkins coughs.

scenes.title: Freeze it

lines.text: [instructing] Perkins, pour the liquid nitrogen onto the hull.
[hesitant] Right, sir. Pouring it on now...
[shouts] Ah! It splashed back! My boots are frozen!
[dryly] Excellent. You cannot run away now.

scenes.direction: Liquid splashes onto the hull, immediate freezing hiss and crystalline crackle. Blue-white waves follow the sound. Perkins reacts during the freezing effect.

scenes.title: The mystery port

lines.text: [matter-of-fact] There's a maintenance port beneath the engine. Twist that valve.
[nervous] It's opening! Oh. Oh, that's... green.

scenes.direction: Metallic click, wet GLORP-GLORP. Sickly green pulses across G, L and R.

scenes.title: The alien goo

lines.text: [nervous] Professor, the goo is eating my shoe!
[matter-of-fact] Stop exaggerating.
[dryly] You'll need to throw those shoes away. They look like they're infected.

scenes.direction: Bubbling, sizzling, tiny monstrous BURP. Uneven green and purple flickers.

scenes.title: The mysterious knob

lines.text: [matter-of-fact] Aha! An interstellar communications dial. This could be our way in.
[dryly] Or an excellent way to summon something.

scenes.direction: Heavy switch CLICK. Deep oscillating signal, cyan beams sweeping L and R.

scenes.title: First contact

lines.text: [nervous] Professor? Is it talking to us?
[dryly] Regrettably.

scenes.direction: Organic alien conversation over the radio: throaty bubbling speaker, nasal questioning reply, impatient response. Purple and green light pulses track the vocal syllables.

scenes.title: Translation

lines.text: [matter-of-fact] Unit-7, translate.
[dryly] The mothership says this vessel is overdue for inspection.
[nervous] By how much?
[dryly] Four thousand years.

scenes.direction: Low alien chatter, descending electronic tones. Purple pulses fade to red.

scenes.title: The diplomatic approach

lines.text: [matter-of-fact] Tell them we're authorized technicians.
[dryly] I told them we're contagious.
[matter-of-fact] WHY?
[dryly] They've disconnected.

scenes.direction: Disgruntled alien radio reply, soft descending disconnect tones and a click; brief blackout then one red pulse.

scenes.title: Starting the engines

lines.text: [matter-of-fact] Wait. The engines! Their startup cycle might release the door locks.
[alarmed] Are the engines firing up? Look out!

scenes.direction: Engine turbines spool up, thunderous fiery WHOOMPH! G red-orange, L/R searing white. Fog blast.

scenes.title: The eyebrows

lines.text: [nervous] MY EYEBROWS! MY EYEBROWS ARE GONE!
[matter-of-fact] Interesting. The propulsion system is entirely functional.
[dryly] Unlike Perkins' face.

scenes.direction: Engines wind down, sputtering flames and crackling static. Orange fades to darkness.

scenes.title: One last technological solution

lines.text: [matter-of-fact] We'll bypass the lock with a quantum phase inverter.
[dryly] You brought one?
[matter-of-fact] I brought Perkins.

scenes.direction: Warbling dimensional tone, rapid purple-blue alternations. Perkins yelps as the field snaps off.

scenes.title: The professor thinks

lines.text: [matter-of-fact] Why won't it open? Electricity, heat, leverage, quantum manipulation... we've tried everything.
[dryly] You haven't tried leaving.

scenes.direction: Slow electronic heartbeat. Dim cyan pulses alternate between L and R.

scenes.title: The revelation

lines.text: [matter-of-fact] Wait. That symbol! It's not an intergalactic warning. It's a ceremonial offering glyph!
[nervous] Like... candy?
[matter-of-fact] Exactly!

scenes.direction: Sudden discovery chime, golden light spreads from G upward through L and R.

scenes.title: The door finally opens

lines.text: [nervous] TRICK OR TREAT!

scenes.direction: Hydraulic hatch opens, little alien footsteps emerge, then several aliens call Trick or treat together. Green-white reveal pulses follow the chorus; door settles shut and lights fade for the loop.
